create.name: Karma Teachers
create.bio:
Karma Teachers is a registered non-profit yoga school in Vancouver, British Columbia. It began in 2011 as a studio in a heritage building in Gastown, where classes were offered free or by donation every day, and it has been preparing new yoga teachers since 2014. The school takes its name and outlook from karma yoga, the path of selfless service, and keeps its trainings within reach through full and partial scholarships. Since the pandemic it no longer runs its own Gastown room; in-person sessions now meet at Green Room Yoga on East Hastings Street, with live classes also taught online.

Its core programme is a 200-hour Hatha training registered with Yoga Alliance, run as a six-week hybrid: weekend days in the studio and weekday evening sessions over video. Trainees study posture and alignment, sequencing, breathing practice, meditation and yoga nidra, and the history and ethics of yoga, including the yamas and niyamas, with Siddhartha set as reading before the course begins. A fully online version runs over twelve weeks. Past graduates can continue with shorter trainings such as a self-paced Yin course, and the school also arranges trainings in Rishikesh with an Indian partner school. The current lead trainers include Daniel Clement, Jennifer Clarke and Andrew Fredericks.

courses.title: 200 Hour Hatha Yoga Teacher Training (Vancouver, hybrid)
courses.description: A six-week training registered with Yoga Alliance, with weekend days in the studio and three live online evenings a week, plus home study and practice teaching. It covers postures and alignment, sequencing, breathing practice, meditation and the philosophy and ethics of yoga. Cohorts are listed for January, March and May 2027, and partial scholarships are offered.

courses.title: Online 200hr Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: The school's teacher training delivered wholly online over twelve weeks, in two-hour live evening sessions that mix practice, study and teaching drills. Every session is recorded for review, and the same reading list and manual are used as in the studio course.

courses.title: Yin Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A 50-hour Yin course that can be taken at the student's own pace, open both to teachers and to keen practitioners. It looks at the yin and yang philosophy behind the style, long-held postures, breath and meditation, how to build a Yin class, and includes a teaching practicum.

courses.title: Traditional Yoga Teacher Training in India
courses.description: Residential 200, 300 and 500-hour trainings in Rishikesh, arranged by Karma Teachers with the Maharishi Yoga Peeth school there. Lodging, vegetarian meals and outings to local temples are included, and a Karma Teachers trainer gives an orientation before departure.

free_resources.title: Free and donation-based classes
free_resources.description: In keeping with its non-profit aims, the school offers classes that are free or by donation, booked through its live class timetable.
